lean_theorem.reason: BarrierArrhenius and HonestErrors.Kinetics theorems formalize consequences of barrier error; they do not prove the empirical 30-path aggregate MAE.

runtime_gate.reason: No deployed runtime gate consumes the Hard Materials Z1 aggregate barrier-accuracy measurement.

excluded_scope: Barrier accuracy for models other than the declared available models (chgnet, mace-mp-small, mace-mp-medium, mace-mpa-0-medium)
Structures or chemistries outside the 30-path held-out LiTraj nebDFT2k panel
Error-against-experiment framing: references are published DFT-NEB, not experiment
Charged-defect corrections, finite-temperature prefactors, diffusivities, and Arrhenius rates
Battery screening hit-rate claims beyond the barrier-accuracy acceptance test

premises.statement: The content-addressed 30-path LiTraj nebDFT2k barrier panel reports MAE against published DFT-NEB references across 30 held-out chemical systems, below the 40 meV Z1 ceiling.

statement: The Z1 barrier-accurate MLIP screening panel satisfies the Hard Materials Z1 migration-barrier acceptance test (MAE <= 40 meV) on a chemistry-held-out DFT-NEB benchmark.
